texts.zh: 在已经流逝的数千年的某个时间，发生了一次严重的撞击事件，一颗矿物丰富的小行星与[From.GetName]相撞。现在，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的撞击坑周围仍能找到丰富的矿物储藏。
texts.en: A large mineral-rich asteroid collided with [From.GetName] at some point during the previous thousand years in what must have been a major impact event. An abundance of minerals can now be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] in the vicinity of the impact crater.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]上的某个撞击坑似乎是一艘星际飞船撞击留下的。根据坑的大小判断，我们怀疑是一万年前一艘超光速引擎全速开启的飞船由于某些未知原因撞上了[From.GetPlanetMoon]。[Root.GetName]已经在超光速撞击地点附近接收到了残余亚空间回波，但由于飞船已经在撞击中解体，因此我们的猜测无法得到证实。
texts.en:
A massive crater on [From.GetName] appears to be the result of a collision with a starship. From the size of the crater, we suspect that a ship exiting a hyperlane at maximum velocity rammed the [From.GetPlanetMoon] for reasons unknown roughly 10,000 years ago.

The [Root.GetName] has picked up residual subspace echoes near the crash site reminiscent of a collapsed hyperparticulate field, but as the ship itself disintegrated on impact the theory cannot be verified.

# 巨大撞击 / Massive Impact

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:390; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:4224 (anomaly.600); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:4267 (anomaly.605)

## 如何开始 How it starts

不宜居的普通星球可能生成（2级，权重3）。

Can spawn on a regular uninhabitable planet (level 2, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.600“小行星碰撞”（采矿矿藏 d_minerals_3 + asteroid_collision 修正；星球有战略资源时权重为0）与 anomaly.605“超光速碰撞”（每月物理研究加成）。图片随生物舰船帝国变化。

anomaly.600 "Asteroid Collision" (d_minerals_3 deposit plus asteroid_collision modifier; weight 0 if the planet has a strategic resource) and anomaly.605 "FTL Impact" (monthly physics research). The picture changes for bio-ship empires.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个结果互斥，各50%；有战略资源时只会得到 605。

The results are exclusive, 50% each; with a strategic resource only 605.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异。

No empire differences.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与全部结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。

Checked the anomaly definition and every outcome event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed.
